metaTitle: Custom Acrylic Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom acrylic badge ID holders in bulk. Durable, clear, and perfect for your team. Get your quote today!
introHtml: Acrylic badge ID holders offer a sleek, professional look with the durability to withstand daily wear. Unlike softer plastic holders, acrylic resists yellowing and scratches, making it ideal for high-traffic environments like hospitals, factories, or corporate offices. Choose from vertical or horizontal orientations and add your logo with screen printing or a full-color insert. Perfect for security badges, visitor passes, or employee IDs.
heroAltText: Clear custom acrylic badge ID holders with printed logo and lanyard for employee identification
